name: android-project-initial-setup
description: Scaffolds a new production-ready Android project from scratch after interviewing you for the app basics. Lets you choose MVVM-only (small projects) or Clean Architecture with MVVM (larger apps), and asks whether you need local persistence (Room), a remote API (Retrofit), user settings (DataStore), and where work will be tracked. Follows Google's official architecture guidance with Jetpack Compose, Hilt, and an offline-first data layer.
